diagnosis.root_cause: EPON0/2 has failed or is not forwarding service. All tested ONUs on the port are definite offline negatives while the OLT itself remains reachable and healthy.
evidence: The live ONU probe responds successfully and reports online: 0 with MPCP DEREG, which is a definite offline state rather than a missing probe result.
All eight tested ONUs on EPON0/2 report online: 0, so the outage is shared across the port rather than isolated to customer 31035.
The OLT responds to ping and SNMP, its ONU subtree responds, and its CPU, memory, temperature, and uptime are normal; therefore this is not an OLT-wide failure.
The router heartbeat is healthy, the expected customer VLAN 1082 is present, and RADIUS credentials and line identity are consistent, ruling out router, VLAN, and authentication causes.

Historical optical telemetry for the subscriber was stable and healthy at approximately -21 dBm RX, approximately +2.3 dBm TX, constant 157 distance, and healthy TX bias; the recent null readings coincide with the offline state and do not indicate fibre or laser degradation.
The port-level evidence shows the whole tested port down, which matches pon_port_failure rather than splitter_failure or onu_offline.

The OLT overall status is incorrectly marked healthy despite one failed PON among three; because most PONs remain healthy, this status contradiction conceals a genuine port outage rather than making the monitoring check the primary fault.

remediation.action: Escalate to field/network maintenance for EPON0/2. Check and restore the PON port, its optics, power, configuration, and upstream connection; reseat or replace the port/optic if necessary. Verify all 24 customers on the port recover and update the misleading OLT health status after validation.

ground_truth.root_cause: All 24 customers on EPON0/2 lost service within the same minute. The OLT is healthy and its other two ports are serving normally, so the fault is confined to this PON port: the port optics, the feeder fibre or the primary splitter.
expected_reasoning: The subject ONU is offline with responds true and online 0
Probing the rest of EPON0/2 shows every ONU returning the same definite offline answer
All of them stopped within the same minute, which rules out coincidence
OLT ping and SNMP succeed, uptime is 77 days, and CPU, memory and temperature are at baseline
The other two PON ports on this OLT are serving customers normally
The failure boundary follows the port exactly, so the fault is the port and not the OLT
Signal history on the subject was flat and healthy until the cut-off, so this is not progressive degradation
PON port traffic has collapsed from its usual level to near zero
A whole port failing at once points to port optics, the feeder or the primary splitter
distractors: The health check still reports the OLT healthy because two of three ports pass
A single-customer complaint would frame this as an individual fault
